ios.desc:
Money management should be simple. GlanceBook makes it effortless.

“Where did all my money go this month?”
“I want to keep a budget, but it feels like too much work…”

If these thoughts sound familiar, GlanceBook is here to help.
We have focused only on the features you truly need, providing a clean and intuitive budgeting experience that is both easy to read and easy to use.

With just the essentials and a clear view of your income and expenses, managing your finances becomes simpler and more effective.

■ Budgeting Made Simple
See your spending habits at a glance and take small, meaningful steps toward better financial health. Record your daily transactions quickly and effortlessly.

■ Key Features
• All-in-one view – Check today’s spending and this month’s totals in a single glance.
• Beautiful, organized categories – Record income and expenses with category icons for easy recognition.
• Visual insights – bar charts clearly show where your money is going.
• Category summaries – See which categories took the largest share of your budget each month.
• Effortless entry – Minimal typing for quick and simple recording.

■ Recommended For
• Those who often lose track of where their money goes
• People who want to keep a budget but find it too tedious
• Anyone unsure why their balance keeps decreasing
• Users looking for a clean, intuitive budgeting tool
